A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the PVYNT N and PVYN Wi strains induce a more pronounced and similar miRNA response than the mild PVYZ NTN strain, and that the observed miRNA changes are associated with the severity of the symptoms.
the miRNA response in the PVYNT and PVYN infected tobacco plants is host dependent and corresponds with the symptom severity.

the miRNA expression profiles in tobacco plants are altered by the PVY strains in an HC Pro dependent manner, and the miRNA response is host dependent and correlates with the viral symptom severity and viral HC Pro RNA accumulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the miRNA response to PVY infection is host specific, and that the miRNA balance is altered in a strain specific manner.
miRNAs are involved in host responses to PVY infection and that miRNAs and miRNA targets are differentially regulated depending on PVY strains.
PVY strains with different symptom severity cause different miRNA responses in the same host plant.
